name: Sora
summary: OpenAI's text-to-video app for creating and remixing short clips from prompts.
description: Sora is OpenAI's video generation product at sora.com. Signed-in ChatGPT users can create, remix, and share short videos from text prompts. Availability and limits depend on your ChatGPT plan; check OpenAI's help center for your region.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Included with eligible ChatGPT plans; limits vary by tier and region.
